svg.title: Two PI-controlled heaters with a load sine and a noise sine
svg.desc: After the first two cycles, which are shaded, the 10 kilowatt load sine moves the water by 0.559 degrees Celsius and the heater command by 3.97 percentage points. The 0.05 degree noise sine moves the water by 0.0397 degrees, the controller's reading by 0.0395 degrees and the command by 0.281 points.
svg.text: Two PI-controlled heaters: a 10 kW load sine and a 0.05 °C noise sine at 0.2 rad/s
Control Studio recording of this project · C = 5 + 1/s · numbers answer the predictions
Time after the start of the sines (s)
0.281 % for 0.0395 °C read: 7.1 %/°C, as for the load
